event: Termux session became unavailable during metadata recording after model download
suspected_cause: Python Path.read_bytes() attempted to allocate the entire 18.56 GB model while redundantly computing SHA-256; command produced no JSON artifact and returned without output. This likely exceeded the Termux app memory limit.
response: Hash already collected with streaming sha256sum; future hash operations must stream fixed-size blocks. Model loading is still untested. Retry runner now admits only with >=5 GiB MemAvailable, charging, cool CPU/HTP/battery, explicit -lm mmap, one HTP layer, context 64, and one output token; it aborts below 2 GiB MemAvailable.
